name: Bajaj Holdings & Investment Ltd.
business_summary: Listed investment holding company of the Bajaj group (promoters 51.46%). Its value is a portfolio of stakes in Bajaj Finserv (~38-39%), Bajaj Auto, Maharashtra Scooters and other investments, with NAV per share Rs21,062 (investments Rs2.34 lakh cr at 30 Jun 2026) against a share price of Rs10,799: a ~49% discount to NAV. Revenue (Rs924cr TTM) is dividends and interest from investees; reported consolidated profit (Q2 FY27 Rs1,993cr owner profit, +28% y/y; TTM Rs9,440cr) is dominated by its share of associates' earnings under equity accounting (book value Rs6,630/share). Interim dividend Rs65/share in Sep 2026. P/E 12.9, dividend yield 1.4%.

revenue_mix.segment: Dividend and interest income from investments

exposures.mechanism: Holdco discount to NAV (~49% on 30 Jun NAV: price Rs10,799 vs NAV Rs21,062) widens when yields rise; stock P/E 12.9, P/B 1.6 (BV Rs6,630). +25bp => discount +1pt of NAV (~2% of price) at 40% pass-through => -0.8. Underlying holdings' own rate sensitivity is captured via the company links.

exposures.mechanism: Holdco-level effect only (the Bajaj Finserv/Bajaj Finance funding-cost impact flows through the BAJAJFINSV link): hikes slow NBFC/insurance growth sentiment that determines the holdco discount; -0.6 at low confidence.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening' (The Hindu, Reuters headlines)

exposures.mechanism: DII share 8.4% (up from 8.1%); SIP/DII +10% supports mid/large cap holdco demand and narrows the NAV discount (+2pt of discount -> +4% only if sustained); take +1.0.
FII 9.6%; beta 0.94-1.06; +US$5bn/qtr ~ +3% Nifty => +3%, one-third survives demeaning => +1.0.

No direct FX in a holdco; pack -2.51 per +3% USD/INR (t -1.7) arises from INR weakness coinciding with FPI outflows from financials. Shrunk to -1.0 as the FPI edge already carries part of that channel (de-duplicate).
Pack: +1.61 per +5% S&P (t +2.1; market beta 0.94). Interpretation: global risk-on lifts financials/FPI flows. Shrunk by half to +0.8 to avoid duplicating the FPI/VIX channel.
Pack -0.63 per +5 VIX points (t -1.5, consistent). Holdco discounts widen in risk-off periods.

Holdco taxation (low effective tax noted by Screener: dividends from investees taxed) and investor demand for equity; a higher LTCG/STCG regime also lowers the monetisation value of holdings and the NAV multiple. Union Budget 1 Feb 2027. Low confidence.

Portfolio is dominated by financial-services holdings (Bajaj Finserv/Finance/insurance) whose valuations ride financialisation; fully captured via the holdings link, so only a small holdco-premium residual (+1.0).

company_links.mechanism: Largest holding (about 39% of Bajaj Finserv per Trendlyne/Roic listings; added shares in April 2026 block deals: stake 38.41%). Investments' market value Rs2.34 lakh cr on 30 Jun 2026; BFS+Bajaj Auto each about one-third by value (weights from Trendlyne/Roic, unverified). A +1% move in BFS lifts NAV ~0.35-0.4%; the holdco follows NAV at ~1:1 (discount stable), so w=+0.38 (% change in BAJAJHLDNG per +1% in BFS).
